_comment: Open models suggested for download, keyed by Ollama tag. Curate as better models ship. download_gb is the Q4 download size; moe marks mixture-of-experts models, which stay fast on CPUs despite their size.

models.name: Qwen3 1.7B
models.description: Very small and quick. Fine for simple questions and short texts.

models.name: Qwen3 4B
models.description: Small but capable, with a thinking mode for harder questions.

models.name: Gemma 3 4B
models.description: Small, good at writing, understands images.

models.name: Qwen3 8B
models.description: Solid everyday assistant, good at following instructions.

models.name: Qwen3 14B
models.description: Noticeably smarter than 8B models, still reasonably quick on a GPU.

models.name: gpt-oss 20B
models.description: OpenAI's open model. Good reasoning and tool use, fast for its size.

models.name: Gemma 3 27B
models.description: Large, high-quality writing and image understanding.

models.name: Qwen3 32B
models.description: Among the strongest models that fit on a single large GPU.

models.name: Llama 3.3 70B
models.description: Very capable; needs a workstation-class GPU or lots of unified memory.

models.name: gpt-oss 120B
models.description: Near frontier quality for those with the memory to run it.
